source.check: Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 28 September 1946, p. 6; dated 21 September 1946), read on the page image: names in column 6 with no votes in column 5, 'where no Polls have been taken'; party labels from the Northern Whig's unopposed list of 20 September 1946, p. 3

note: Triennial election, polled (if necessary) Thursday 3 October 1946. There was no contest: the Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 21 September 1946 and printed in the Mid-Ulster Mail of 28 September 1946, p. 6, declares the sixteen candidates duly elected for their divisions, no polls having been taken. Labels (nine Unionists, seven Nationalists) are as printed in the Northern Whig's unopposed list of 20 September 1946, p. 3, which gives no divisions. Returned unopposed.
